gamefaqs.product: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
gamefaqs.section: Wii VC Game Save File (North America)

format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-NACE "Zelda: Ocarina", 1 file: RAM_CZLE 32768 bytes - RAM_CZLE is the N64 cartridge save in console byte order

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-1998.30445.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes RAM_CZLE (32768 bytes, SRAM): first 0x8000 bytes, 32-bit words reversed, at 0x20800

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

note: RAM_CZLE: the VC names the file after the cartridge's game code. The SRAM's backup slots hold an older file "John"; the game reads the primary slot. Verified with Rev 2, the library's US release.
